title: finding(types): the three AI node declarations in `ai.ts` disagree with their renderers: five `on*` members typed `string` (the handler dialect objectui#6182 withdrew), and `config` / `context` that nothing in `@object-ui/plugin-ai` reads
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect family with named sites, classes (b) and (c), one surface: `AIFormAssistSchema`, `AIRecommendationsSchema` and `NLQuerySchema` in `packages/types/src/ai.ts`. `reach:` authoring face. The TS face publishes members an author may write that no runtime honours, and PR objectui#10870 now mirrors that face in zod. Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat #2, `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`, from the objectui#10859 batch-1 dev report (`5861203718`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]` and `[2]`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Read by this seat (objectui `origin/main` `f905090a1`)

- **Handler members typed `string` on the TS face.**
  - `AIFormAssistSchema` declares `onApplySuggestion?: string` and `onRejectSuggestion?: string`.
  - `AIRecommendationsSchema` declares `onSelect?: string` and `onDismiss?: string`.
  - `NLQuerySchema` declares `onSubmit?: string`.
  - That is the handler-expression dialect objectui#6182 withdrew on either face.
- **Reads in `@object-ui/plugin-ai` (non-test `src`):**
  - `AIRecommendations` and `NLQueryInput` take `onSelect`, `onDismiss` and `onSubmit` as React FUNCTION props, and call them. None reads them from `schema`.
  - `onApplySuggestion` and `onRejectSuggestion` have zero reads.
- **`config?: AIConfig`** (all three declarations) and **`context?: Record OF (string, any)`** (two of them) have zero reads in `@object-ui/plugin-ai`.
- PR objectui#10870 (objectui#10859 batch 1) gives these declarations zod arms. Its arms refuse the five `on*` members with `handlerKeyRefusal`, the objectui#6182 / objectui#6124 house rule, and pin that divergence from the TS face both ways. The arms mirror `config` and `context` as declared.

## Why it matters

- An author, or an AI, reading the TS face writes `onSelect: "…"` or `config: { … }`, and nothing happens.
- The `on*` strings are refused by the new zod arm but offered by the TS face, so the two faces disagree by design until the TS face is fixed.
- The `config` and `context` members are declared but unenforced (ADR-0049).

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- **`on*` members, per objectui#6124:** where a renderer calls a handler, the TS face types it as a function (a host prop, not JSON), or retires it from the node face. Where nothing calls it (`onApplySuggestion`, `onRejectSuggestion`), it becomes `?: never`.
- **`config` / `context`:** enforce-or-remove under ADR-0049. Measure first whether any host (app-shell, console, examples) reads them off the node before choosing.
- Serial: after PR objectui#10870 lands, since its arm and pins name these members.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #10213), were listed via REST and grepped locally:
- `onApplySuggestion` / `onRejectSuggestion`: 1 hit, PR objectui#10870;
- `AIFormAssistSchema` / `AIRecommendationsSchema` / `NLQuerySchema` near config / context / unread: 1 hit, PR objectui#10870.

Dedupe words: `ai.ts handler string dialect` · `onApplySuggestion string` · `AI schema on* members 6124` · `AI schema config zero reads` · `ai-form-assist context inert`
